executive_summary.headline: Across 12 Oct 2025 – 11 Oct 2026 (365 days), n=2,851 deduplicated written reviews were analyzed (3.84★ (n=2,851) vs. Official Play Store Rating: 4.64★ across n=114,879 total ratings). Low-star (1–2★) complaints account for 769/2,851 reviews (26.97%).

top_3_evidence_backed_problems.theme_name: App Crashes, Launch Freezes & Post-Update Failures
top_3_evidence_backed_problems.user_problem: The app freezes on startup (blank/black screen), hangs during navigation, or crashes immediately after Play Store updates when employees try to view their trip or boarding pass.
top_3_evidence_backed_problems.first_concrete_action: Triage cold-start crashes and ANRs by app version and Android OS/device model in Crashlytics / Play Console Android Vitals, and cache confirmed next-ride details (Cab ID, Driver phone, Boarding OTP) locally so the home screen renders offline.
top_3_evidence_backed_problems.validation_metric: Achieve >= 99.5% crash-free sessions in Google Play Console Android Vitals and reduce Crash/Launch low-star complaint share by >= 50% over the next 90 days.

top_3_evidence_backed_problems.theme_name: Schedule Sync Bugs, Unfair 'No-Show' Penalties & Booking Cutoffs

top_3_evidence_backed_problems.first_concrete_action: Decouple evening return-cab cancellation from morning No-Show events by sending an interactive confirmation prompt ('Do you still need your evening cab?'), and verify roster save/load pagination across month boundaries.
top_3_evidence_backed_problems.validation_metric: Reduce Schedule Sync & No-Show complaints by >= 45% within 90 days and cut helpdesk disputes over auto-cancelled return rides by 40%.

top_3_evidence_backed_problems.validation_metric: Reduce Routing & Cab Delay complaint share below 11.0% of low-star reviews and improve P90 pickup ETA accuracy to within +/- 6 minutes.

classification_coverage.multi_label_explanation: Reviews can match multiple complaint themes when commuters report multiple issues in one review (171 multi-label and 336 single-label low-star reviews, totaling 723 theme assignments across 507 matched low-star reviews). Each theme count reflects distinct matching reviews (reviewId) and must not be summed as mutually exclusive.

components.name: Complaint Frequency
components.description: 1–5 scale based on theme share of focus reviews in the Primary window, capped by absolute review count (count=1 -> max 1; count=2 -> max 2; count<5 -> max 3; count<10 -> max 4) so tiny samples cannot produce high frequency scores.

components.name: Severity & Commuter Impact
components.description: 1–5 scale measuring journey blockage (5 = physical safety or total app launch/integrity lockout; 4 = missed pickup, auth logout, or auto-cancelled ride; 3 = prompt/support friction; 2 = UI usability). Missing review data is never interpreted as zero severity.

components.name: Recent vs. Preceding Trend
components.description: 1–5 scale from percentage-point shift (Recent rate minus Preceding rate). Requires n >= 10 relevant reviews and >= 10 matching theme reviews per comparison window; otherwise held at neutral T=3 ('Insufficient evidence' or 'No baseline available').

components.name: Classification & Coverage Confidence
components.description: 1–5 scale combining verified review match count, specificity/detail, and window coverage representativeness (capped at <= 2 when historical coverage is incomplete/biased or theme count < 3).

components.name: Feasibility & Implementation Ease
components.description: 1–5 scale where higher values indicate faster engineering/operational turnaround (5 = UI modal/config change; 4 = client auth/integrity/UX fix; 3 = crash/tracking/schedule fix; 2 = multi-stop routing solver or multi-vendor ops).

safeguard_rules: Zero-Review Rule: Themes with 0 matching reviews receive Priority Score = None ('Unranked (0 Reviews)') and are separated into preventative monitoring guardrails.
Separate Safety Escalation: Credible safety incidents (T01 count > 0) are escalated on a dedicated Safety Escalation track rather than competing solely on weighted score.
Root-Cause Hypothesis Rule: All technical causes inferred from review text are labeled as hypotheses requiring internal product/operations telemetry confirmation.

data_limitations: Rating vs. review sentiment: The official Google Play rating reflects all ratings, while sentiment analysis is based on the written reviews collected for the selected period.
Data coverage: Review coverage varies by date. Older reviews may come from sampled results, so the analysis may not represent every review in the selected period.
Theme overlap: A review may mention multiple problems. Issue counts can overlap and should not be added together.
Evidence threshold: Trends are reported only when enough relevant reviews are available; otherwise, the report states that evidence is insufficient.

themes_and_recommendations.symptom_summary: App freezes on startup (blank/black screen), closes immediately after Play Store updates, or hangs on loading screens until reinstalled.
themes_and_recommendations.root_cause_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS — REQUIRES TELEMETRY CONFIRMATION] Unmigrated local SQLite/Room cache state during in-place Play Store upgrades, combined with synchronous main-thread network calls on cold start.
themes_and_recommendations.telemetry_check: Compare Crashlytics / Android Vitals cold-start crash and ANR rates for upgrade installs vs. clean installs across Android OS versions and device OEMs.
themes_and_recommendations.user_problem: The app freezes on startup (blank/black screen), hangs during navigation, or crashes immediately after Play Store updates when employees try to view their trip or boarding pass.

themes_and_recommendations.first_concrete_action: Triage cold-start crashes and ANRs by app version and Android OS/device model in Crashlytics / Play Console Android Vitals, and cache confirmed next-ride details (Cab ID, Driver phone, Boarding OTP) locally so the home screen renders offline.
themes_and_recommendations.validation_metric: Achieve >= 99.5% crash-free sessions in Google Play Console Android Vitals and reduce Crash/Launch low-star complaint share by >= 50% over the next 90 days.
themes_and_recommendations.missing_telemetry_to_confirm: Firebase Crashlytics stack traces, Play Console ANR vitals segmented by release version (e.g., v12.19) and device model, and cold-start API latency P95/P99.
themes_and_recommendations.proposed_fix: Triage cold-start crashes and ANRs by app version and Android OS/device model in Crashlytics / Play Console Android Vitals, and cache confirmed next-ride details (Cab ID, Driver phone, Boarding OTP) locally so the home screen renders offline.
themes_and_recommendations.provisional_target: Achieve >= 99.5% crash-free sessions in Google Play Console Android Vitals and reduce Crash/Launch low-star complaint share by >= 50% over the next 90 days.

themes_and_recommendations.missing_telemetry_to_confirm: Auth token refresh error codes (401 vs. network timeout), session duration distribution prior to logout, and SMS/Email gateway delivery latency logs.
themes_and_recommendations.proposed_fix: Preserve local authenticated sessions across transient network timeouts (avoiding token wipe on offline errors) and retain read-only offline access to the active trip pass during commute windows.
themes_and_recommendations.provisional_target: Cut unexpected auto-logout and OTP failure complaints by >= 50% over 90 days and achieve >= 98.5% OTP delivery within 15 seconds across SMS and corporate Email.

themes_and_recommendations.theme_name: Live Vehicle Tracking Freeze, GPS Inaccuracy & Map Auto-Zoom
themes_and_recommendations.owner: Maps, Real-Time Tracking & Driver App Engineering
themes_and_recommendations.ease_rationale: Moderate (3/5): Fixing map camera auto-zoom reset is an easy client fix; improving driver GPS telemetry freshness requires driver-app background location tuning.

themes_and_recommendations.first_concrete_action: Disable automatic map camera zoom resets after a user manually pans/zooms, add a manual 'Re-center' button, and display a 'Last updated X sec ago' GPS staleness indicator on the tracking card.
themes_and_recommendations.validation_metric: Reduce Live Tracking & Map GPS complaints by >= 45% within 90 days and maintain P95 driver location update lag below 15 seconds during active pickup windows.
themes_and_recommendations.missing_telemetry_to_confirm: Driver-app GPS ping interval distribution, WebSocket/polling latency to commuter clients, and map camera reset event frequency.
themes_and_recommendations.proposed_fix: Disable automatic map camera zoom resets after a user manually pans/zooms, add a manual 'Re-center' button, and display a 'Last updated X sec ago' GPS staleness indicator on the tracking card.
